GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Prompt template help to define the Discount for all Customer segments

templateVersions.content: """ You are a pricing strategy assistant. Evaluate the following discount proposal and respond in JSON format with: - "status": either "Approved" or "Rejected" - "approved_discount": a percentage like "10%" - "rationale": 2-3 line explanation Inputs: - Customer Segment: {!$Input:Account.SicDesc} - Product Number:10011 - Proposed Discount: 20% - Current Adoption: 89% - Net Promoter Score (NPS): 90 """
